recap.text: The Lady Dominators and the Gimp are two womantaurs, Genesis and Rapture, and a half-mantaur named Corky in a burgundy Pontiac GTO. Genesis kills an upgrade engineer with arm chains to keep him from Carl. After refusing to let Dong Quixote see Corky, the team finishes second in Heat Four. In Heat Five, rockets hit the GTO and it falls through a trapped floor in the Gasworks factory, leaving the team eliminated.

beats.headline: A name on the results board
beats.text: Heat One, results. First place, One Fine Pig. Second, the Jugglers. Third place goes to a team called Lady Dominators and the Gimp, a name that raises questions it does not answer. The Royal Court of Princess Donut finishes seventh of the eight survivors, having spent much of the heat towing team Free Love home. The Trauco Triplets are eliminated. Nobody on the court has met the Dominators yet.
beats.gist: Lady Dominators and the Gimp place third in Heat One, while the Royal Court finishes seventh.

beats.headline: Cowboy hats and boots on hands
beats.text: The neighbours arrive. Two womantaurs in sleek white racing suits with a red-and-blue stripe, white cowboy hats, and long black boots on all four lower limbs, which turn out to be a second pair of hands. Genesis, black-haired, level ninety-five, does the talking, in an accent Crawler Carl places in Kentucky. Rapture, freckled and red-haired, chews tobacco and spits. Both are Lady Mantaur Dominators, and unlike every mantaur Carl has met they do not worship Grull but Enyo. Rapture harpoons a rolling beer can to sniff it.
beats.gist: Genesis and Rapture, two Lady Mantaur Dominators in white racing suits, arrive wearing boots on hands.

beats.headline: The third member, zipped in
beats.text: In the doorway of garage number three stands the gimp: a figure in a shiny black vinyl bodysuit with a zipper at the mouth, split vertically down the middle, one leg, one side of a face. Half of a mantaur. He waves a top hand before the door lowers. He is Corky, the friend Dong Quixote has been searching for, and he races with the Dominators. A quest opens on the spot to bring the two together.
beats.gist: Corky, a half-mantaur in a vinyl bodysuit, races with the Dominators and triggers a reunion quest.

beats.headline: A burgundy GTO and a hooked engineer
beats.text: Their vehicle is a late-sixties Pontiac GTO convertible in deep burgundy, under a wide, clearly visible shield, with Corky out cold in the back, hanging over the side. In the second heat, working an arrangement with the court against the boss, Genesis is meant to fish a dead joey out of the boss's pouch with her arm chains. She hooks the upgrade engineer inside instead, kills him, and drops him at Crawler Carl's feet: she was not about to let Carl have the engineer. The Dominators finish fifth.
beats.gist: Genesis hooks an upgrade engineer with arm chains, kills him, and drops him at Carl's feet.

beats.headline: The door that stays shut
beats.text: Dong, Bucket Boy and Splash Zone are on the Dominators' driveway, Dong wanting Corky. The door stays closed. Dong goes down on the driveway with a health bar and nothing visible wrong with him, and still calls for Corky. From inside, Genesis tells him to go away, you freak. Rapture adds that Corky says he hates him now. Laughter follows. Dong is carried off to be looked at, and the garage door does not open.
beats.gist: Dong, Bucket Boy and Splash Zone stand on the Dominators' driveway while Dong calls for Corky.

beats.headline: Blown over the line
beats.text: In the third heat the Dominators are under the impression that they and the court are working together, and the GTO runs close behind the court's truck for much of the course. At the finish, Team Sparkles comes up on the left and fires its cannon across the line into both the food truck and the GTO. All three vehicles go over the line airborne. The Dominators finish third.
beats.gist: Team Sparkles fires a cannon into the food truck and the GTO, sending three vehicles airborne.

beats.headline: Second, and a grudge
beats.text: Heat Four. Team Sparkles screams at them from the starting line, and Crawler Carl judges they very likely hold a grudge over the blast at the last finish, which puts Corky at risk. The GTO takes the same trail as the court, and Genesis, in the passenger seat, gives the truck a four-armed obscene gesture on the way past. In Satan's Water Park they trade blows with the unicorn at the loop. The Dominators finish second.
beats.gist: Team Sparkles screams at Carl and the Gimp in Heat Four; the Dominators finish second.

beats.headline: Corky is nontransferable
beats.text: The court comes to take Corky out of their garage before Heat Five, and they were listening. The door opens, and the GTO rolls out for the starting line on tyres that look to be made of gold, Corky unconscious in the back; on the way to the start it may not be attacked. They invite Porky to hop in: they would love a matched set. Rapture says they heard about the fleshmancer, and they would unzip Corky and let him spill before handing him over. He is nontransferable, says Genesis. See you in the factory, says Rapture.
beats.gist: The court takes Corky from a garage before Heat Five.

beats.headline: Eliminated in the factory
beats.text: Rockets from Prepotente's tapir hit the GTO, and it went through a trapped floor in the Gasworks factory and landed on its side ten metres down, axle broken, a golden wheel sheared off, its containment failed. Cocaine-infused action figures went to work on it. The court took Corky out of the back and drove on, and rejoined him to his other half in its own truck. Heat Five, results, final line: Eliminated, Lady Dominators and the Gimp.
beats.gist: Rockets from Prepotente's tapir hit the GTO, which fell through a trapped floor in the Gasworks factory.
